newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Tuesday amid squaring of positions on the last clearing day and dealers said the market was likely to remain bearish on Wednesday.
"Lack of demand from major players prompted retail investors to offload blue chips," dealer Ali Raza Mooney said, adding that the market would continue to fall in the next few sessions.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 23.64 points, or 1.48 percent, to end at 1,569.97. Losers led gainers 268 to 39. Turnover rose to 43 million shares from Monday's 27 million.

Faysal Bank fell 1.30 rupees to 25.60, Askari Bank 1.0 to 28, Dewan Salman Fibre 1.05 to 40.45, Hub Power Co 0.15 to 38.40 and Pakistan State Oil 2.0 to 298. PTCL fell 0.35 to 29.75, ICI Pakistan 0.15 to 24.65 and Engro Chemical 3.0 to 176.
